verdict.rationale: A live probe returned HTTP 200 for https://help.shopify.com/llms.txt, which describes itself as a guide for AI agents and crawlers to Shopify's official documentation. The Shopify POS help and developer pages are also served at .md URLs, so an agent can be pointed at them directly. The 404 probe only tested a doubled '.md.md' extension, so it does not contradict this. missing for 10: evidence that the llms.txt indexes POS-specific pages, independent hands-on corroboration of agents using these docs, a POS-specific agent-oriented docs section

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
